title: termux-sync: Arbitrary file write during restore via attacker-controlled manifest source path (CVE-2026-86046)
description: termux-sync versions prior to 1.2.4 contain a vulnerability in the restore functionality where the backup manifest's 'source' field is not validated. This allows an attacker to control the extraction destination path during restore, leading to arbitrary file writes anywhere the Termux user can write. Malicious backups can overwrite shell startup files or executable scripts, enabling local code execution upon later use. The vulnerability arises because the restore process trusts untrusted manifest fields and does not enforce path restrictions or sanitize backup names.
